package app

import (
	"context"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"alder/rt/db"
	"alder/rt/eff"
	"alder/rt/html"
	rtesting "alder/rt/testing"
)

// TestAlderFakes runs the gen_fakes golden's tests (a test build) as `alder test` does, with
// the fakes' tables after the app's (FakeTables) and no adapters wired (TestGen_Fakes).
func TestAlderFakes(t *testing.T) {
	if len(FakeTables) != 1 || FakeTables[0].Name != "Payments.Charge" {
		t.Fatalf("FakeTables: %+v", FakeTables)
	}
	rs := rtesting.Run(Tests, rtesting.Options{Tables: Tables, TestTables: FakeTables, Caps: Caps{}.Registry(), Session: TestSession()})
	got := map[string]rtesting.Result{}
	for _, r := range rs {
		got[r.Module+" "+r.Name] = r
	}
	for _, name := range []string{
		"Payments a refund marks the charge",
		"Checkout a charge is recorded",
		"Checkout a declined charge leaves no row",
		"Checkout the balance counts what is not refunded",
		"Shop installs and reads back",
	} {
		if r := got[name]; !r.OK {
			t.Errorf("%s: %+v", name, r)
		}
	}
	// the lifecycle's trace: Test.fake, then the entries by their capability's names, each
	// followed by the fake's own steps
	wantTrace := []string{"Test.fake Stripe", "Db.insert User", "Stripe.charge", "Db.insert Charge", "Stripe.refund",
		"Db.get Charge", "Db.update Charge", "Db.get Charge", "Db.count Charge"}
	if tr := got["Checkout a charge is recorded"].Trace; !reflect.DeepEqual(tr, wantTrace) {
		t.Errorf("lifecycle trace %q, want %q", tr, wantTrace)
	}
	if r := got["Checkout a declined charge fails the test"]; r.OK || r.Error != "card declined" ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(r.Trace, []string{"Test.fake Stripe", "Db.insert User", "Stripe.charge", "Db.insert Charge"}) {
		t.Errorf("a failing entry outside Test.run: %+v", r)
	}
	if r := got["Checkout no fake leaks into the next test"]; r.OK || r.Error != "capability Payments.Stripe is not wired in tests" {
		t.Errorf("a fake leaked: %+v", r)
	}
}

// A fake's Query entry runs as a Query inside a running Query, and a fake called with a
// context that carries no running effect says so.
func TestFakeQueryEntry(t *testing.T) {
	md := Fakes["Markdown.Markdown"]().(Cap__Markdown__Markdown)
	env := &eff.Env{Caps: map[string]any{}}
	n, err := eff.RunQuery(env, eff.Q(eff.Call("Markdown.render", false, func(e *eff.Env) (html.Node, error) {
		return md.Render(e.Ctx, Args__Markdown__Markdown__Render{Value: "hi"})
	})))
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(n, html.Text("hi")) {
		t.Fatalf("n=%v err=%v", n, err)
	}
	if _, err := md.Render(context.Background(), Args__Markdown__Markdown__Render{Value: "x"}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "fake Markdown called outside a running effect") {
		t.Fatalf("outside an effect: %v", err)
	}
	// a write reached from a Query is the runtime's internal error
	st := Fakes["Payments.Stripe"]().(Cap__Payments__Stripe)
	store, err := db.OpenSQLite(":memory:")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer store.Close()
	if err := store.Ensure(context.Background(), Tables, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := store.CreateTables(context.Background(), FakeTables, Tables); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, err = eff.RunQuery(&eff.Env{Store: store}, eff.Q(eff.Call("Stripe.charge", false, func(e *eff.Env) (any, error) {
		return st.Charge(e.Ctx, Args__Payments__Stripe__Charge{Cents: 1, User: "u"})
	})))
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), `write effect "Db.insert Charge" reached from a Query`) {
		t.Fatalf("a Task entry inside a Query: %v", err)
	}
}
